主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed an annual report titled '40-F' with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 31, 2016. The report covers the fiscal year ended December 31, 2015, and includes the Annual Information Form and Audited Annual Financial Statements. The document is incorporated by reference into several registration statements, including Form S-8, F-10, and F-3. It references the Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Results (MD&A) and outlines the financial reporting and disclosure controls for a U.S. company. The report includes certifications, disclosure controls and procedures, and management's annual report on internal control over financial reporting. The company's principal executive officer and principal financial officer evaluated the effectiveness of the disclosure controls and procedures, concluding that they were designed at a reasonable assurance level and were effective to provide reasonable assurance that information required to be disclosed is recorded, processed, summarized, and reported within the time periods specified. The report highlights that while the controls provide a reasonable level of assurance, they cannot prevent all errors and fraud. The internal control over financial reporting was assessed based on the Internal Control – Integrated Framework (2013) issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission. The document outlines the internal control over financial reporting for Brookfield Asset Management Inc. as of December 31, 2015, with no material weaknesses identified. Deloitte LLP, the independent auditor, issued an Attestation Report, which is included in Exhibit 99.2. The registrant's audit committee includes individuals qualified as 'audit committee financial experts' and deemed 'independent' under NYSE rules. A code of ethics, referred to as the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, applies to key officers and is available on the company's website. The document also mentions the principal accountant fees and services, with details included in the Annual Information Form. The report highlights the company's compliance with NYSE standards and its commitment to transparency and governance. The document outlines the corporate governance practices of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. as required by the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). It details the composition of the audit committee, which includes independent directors such as M. Elyse Allan, Angela F. Braly, and George S. Taylor. The company has determined that 10 of its 16 directors are independent, as defined by NYSE rules. The Hon. Frank J. McKenna serves as the chair of the board of directors and facilitates communication between shareholders and independent directors. The company also adheres to NYSE requirements by adopting and disclosing corporate governance guidelines, which are posted on its website.
